scope: Static source and strict link reachability audit of original property service; never executed or installed, no property/IPC/persistence/APK acceptance
reusable_original_units: Original Bionic property memory/protocol and type validation
SO_PEERCRED plus getpeercon plus SELinux property_service:set checks
Two sockets with original permissions, epoll and protocol error handling
Original protobuf persistence read/write, legacy recovery, notification and async writer
supervisor_boundary_required: PropertyChanged callbacks and control queue require actual event-loop/wakeup/action/service ownership
LoadPersistentProperties InitMessage via socketpair required before persistence is enabled
sys.powerctl/shutdown and ctl.* must have explicit Linux-owned handling/errors; no Android init SecondStageMain invocation or success no-ops
No wholesale RC execution/Android boot; authorized original services need supervised start/stop/restart, labels, identity, cgroups/task-profile policy and readiness ownership

durability_source_risk.observation: WritePersistentProperty returns void and logs write failure; async writer subsequently sends PROP_SUCCESS; synchronous path also lacks propagated persistence error. WritePersistentPropertyFile calls fsync but does not check its return in this source.
durability_source_risk.classification: Source evidence only; no disk-failure runtime reproduction yet. ACK alone not durability acceptance.
required_tests: Permission denial and typed invalid property rejection
readiness publication by actual manager only
Persistent value survive service restart and reopen
Read-only storage, ENOSPC, fsync/rename failures with honest result
ctl/shutdown fail explicitly when unsupported, never reboot Linux from guest property

decision: Reuse original property service implementation as a subsystem with explicit narrow Linux-supervisor integration, not boot init or clone its protocol. Full link succeeds, semantic execution still unproven; do not run link-only artifact as standalone server.
limits: --undefined retains a function root but entry still only calls PropertyInit; no claim StartPropertyService executed
Referenced shutdown/control code does not mean those actions ran
SELinux host gate unresolved; no readiness bypass
Historical map overwrite repaired by original link replay; executable bit-identical, historical map pre-overwrite hash unknown; see map-recovery.json
next: Design and implement a narrowly scoped supervisor boundary preserving real callbacks, controls, persistence loading and errors; first meaningful acceptance is permission-aware cross-process property transaction plus durable restart. Preserve R1-MAC deployment gate and no-VM/no-restart contract.
